## NativeBodyOptions.containerReferences property

Hand the codec each reference whose target is got within the record being read together with that record, so the codec encodes the reference with the record as its container (phases/13 D7, container scoping). A get, create, update or resolution body hands over the item it read; a list body, the row's identifier it already read.

Only a body whose result the codec encodes by a typed plan wants this. Under a passthrough plan the codec converts nothing, so the hand-over would reach the caller as it is. Defaults to `true`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly containerReferences?: boolean;
```
